revision_binding.explanation: Evidence.revision holds a placeholder, not a commit. The consumer repositories get their commits only when `demo/scripts/demo.py prepare` copies each template to demo/.work/repos/<repository> and makes one local commit with a fixed identity and dates. The orchestrator must (1) verify every evidence item of a repository against that prepared commit's tree (file exists; line_start..line_end are within the file; excerpt equals the line's text per excerpt_rule) and refuse to bind any repository with a mismatch; then (2) replace that repository's placeholder with the prepared local commit SHA. Ids are not derived from revisions, so binding changes no dependency or evidence id.

excerpt_rule: Every evidence item covers exactly one line (line_start == line_end); excerpt is that line's exact text with only the surrounding whitespace (indentation, line break) removed, i.e. lines[line_start - 1].strip().

id_derivation.dependency: discovery.ids.fixture_uuid("stripe-demo/dependency/<repository>/<field_path>@<file>:<line>") with file:line of the usage (the last evidence item: the use site): one record per (repository, response field, usage site)
id_derivation.evidence: discovery.ids.evidence_id("stripe-demo/consumer-source", <repository_snapshot_id>, <file>, <line_start>, <line_end>); a line shared by several dependencies is one evidence item
id_derivation.ownership: consumer_org_id, enrollment_id and repository_snapshot_id come from demo/expected/demo-ids.json

endpoint.derivation: discovery.ids.endpoint_id(baseline_contract_snapshot_id, "stripe", "GET", "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}"): the record in the baseline catalog the scan is keyed to

evidence_order: Scanner order (scanner/HANDOFF.md): origin first, use site last - SDK import, client initialization, the client (when it is set up apart from its initialization), SDK call, then the usage line. Analyzer explanations cite the use site, the last located source item.

negative_controls.note: NOT dependencies. Local values named amount (or a local division by 100) with no Stripe SDK response origin. A scanner must not report them as Stripe dependencies, no dependency evidence may point at them, and migrations must leave them unchanged.

items.reason: Divides the storefront's own sales-tax rate in basis points (SALES_TAX_BASIS_POINTS = 825, i.e. 8.25%) by 100 to get a percent. No Stripe SDK response reaches this value, so it is not a dependency; the migration must keep this unrelated division by 100.

A local LoyaltyReward issued by the storefront itself (amount in storefront cents, e.g. WELCOME5 = 500); the field is named amount and divided by 100, but it never comes from a Stripe SDK response, so it is not a dependency and the migration must leave it unchanged.
